payload.summary: Move withSentryConfig import to @sentry/nextjs/config before Sentry v11 (audit F25)
payload.detail: Verified offline: next.config.ts imports withSentryConfig from @sentry/nextjs (installed 10.74.0), which prints 'Importing withSentryConfig from @sentry/nextjs is deprecated and will stop working in v11. Import it from @sentry/nextjs/config instead'. One-line change; do it before any Sentry major upgrade.
